name: HeavierHand
mechanic: Only lets you sell the token the pool has too much of, keeping it balanced.
plain: A pool holds two tokens. This only lets you sell the one there's currently more of, so every trade pushes the pool back toward a 50/50 split. You can't pile more into the side that's already heavy - it self-corrects.
rules: You may only sell whichever token the pool currently holds more of.
Every trade nudges the pool back toward a 50/50 balance.
Swaps that deepen the heavier side are rejected.
